title: Community home page
explain: A simple, community-first welcome for Soshanguve: "Safer streets start with neighbours", live safety alerts, the 24/7 emergency number and three steps to join.

title: Services marketplace (public)
explain: Anyone can browse the security services on offer, with prices or "quotation required". Booking needs a free account.

title: Price list
explain: Every listed service with its price, home protection first. Printable, and also inside the app under Services.

title: One sign-in for everyone
explain: Residents, the company office and security officers all sign in here. The app recognises the account and opens the right area automatically.

title: Create a homeowner account
explain: Residents join for free with name, mobile, email and password, and give POPIA consent. Accounts are active immediately (verification is switched off for now).

title: Privacy policy
explain: POPIA-aligned privacy notice in the company's name. The Admin can replace it with their own policy.

title: Homeowner dashboard
explain: Everything at a glance: panic button (for clients), safety alerts, counts of reports, applications, quotations and bookings, and quick actions.

title: Panic button
explain: Anyone with a complete profile (home address + emergency contact) can hold the big red button for 3 seconds (or tick a box and press Send). It captures GPS where allowed, can be silent, and warns honestly that it needs internet.

title: Panic button: finish your profile first
explain: Until a resident has a home address and an emergency contact on file, the panic page shows a short checklist instead of the button, so responders always know where to go and who to call.

title: Panic alert status
explain: After sending, the client sees each step with times: received by server, shown in the control room, acknowledged, officer dispatched, resolved. Location keeps updating.

title: Report an incident
explain: 22 crime and emergency categories, date and time, place with optional GPS, description, witnesses, injuries, and up to 5 photos, documents or videos.

title: My incident reports
explain: Every report with its reference number and current status.

title: Incident progress
explain: Progress steps and a timeline of updates from the company: received, officer assigned, on scene, resolved, with the outcome.

title: My properties
explain: Homeowners register several properties. Each shows whether it is protected and the latest application.

title: Register a property and apply
explain: Address, GPS, existing security, access and concerns, photos, and the protection services wanted (armed response, monitoring, CCTV…).

title: Register a vehicle
explain: Make, model, registration, colour, year, VIN, driver and photos, with an application for vehicle protection.

title: Application tracking
explain: The customer follows the application through review, quotation, payment and activation, and can message the company or send documents.

title: Quotation to accept
explain: An itemised quotation with VAT. The customer accepts or declines online. It can be printed or saved as PDF.

title: Book a service
explain: Pick date, time, place and duration and add instructions. The company confirms availability and price before it is booked.

title: Booking request
explain: The service request with its progress and any quotation from the company.

title: Emergency contacts
explain: Up to 5 people to notify when the panic button is pressed (SMS sending switches on once a provider is connected).

title: Notifications
explain: In-app updates about reports, applications, quotations, payments and bookings.

title: Profile & security
explain: Change details and password, see signed-in devices, sign out everywhere, and view POPIA consent records.

title: Live control room
explain: Active panic alerts and open incidents with a live map, refreshing every 5 seconds, with an optional alarm sound. Acknowledge, open and dispatch, or call.

title: Panic incident: respond
explain: Map with the client's location trail, protected property and access notes, emergency contacts, dispatch to an officer, status updates and notes.

title: Officer response
explain: The assigned officer marks Accepted, En route, On scene (arrival time recorded) and Completed, and adds photos and notes.

title: My assignments
explain: Each officer sees the incidents assigned to them.

title: Patrol log
explain: Officers check in at areas and checkpoints with notes and optional GPS.

title: Homeowner lookup
explain: Read-only lookup of homeowners. Contact details are partly hidden in lists, and opening a record is logged.

title: Admin dashboard
explain: New reports, open incidents, active emergencies, applications, quotations awaiting acceptance, service requests, payments, clients and protected properties.

title: Incident management
explain: Search and filter by status, category, priority and dates. Panic alerts are highlighted.

title: Incident detail (admin)
explain: Evidence, reporter details, map, internal notes, dispatch and status changes. Opening it marks the report as received.

title: Protection applications
explain: Residential and vehicle applications that need attention.

title: Application review & activation
explain: Review the property and services, require an assessment, request info, prepare a quotation, approve, and activate protection (the customer becomes a client).

title: Prepare a quotation
explain: Line items, quantities, prices, monthly or once-off, validity and VAT. Save a draft or send it to the customer.

title: Quotation & payments
explain: The printable quotation, its status, and recording EFT, cash or card payments against it.

title: Service requests & bookings
explain: Incoming bookings by date, to review, quote, confirm and complete.

title: Services
explain: The company manages its services marketplace: prices, availability, area and photos.

title: Price list management
explain: Set the pricing type, price, unit, order and visibility of every service on one screen. Nothing is deleted; untick Listed to hide a service.

title: Payments
explain: All payments with Excel export. PayFast online payment switches on once merchant keys are added.

title: Homeowners
explain: All homeowners with status and client type. Verify, suspend or mark as client from each record.

title: Leads
explain: Community members who reported incidents or pressed panic but are not clients yet. One click sends a protection offer into their app (at most once every 14 days).

title: Community safety alerts
explain: Publish alerts that appear on the public site and every homeowner dashboard until they expire.

title: Reports
explain: Incidents by category, response times, application conversion, quotes accepted, revenue and services, with Excel export and Save as PDF.

title: Admin & security logins
explain: Create and disable Admin and Security company logins.

title: Branding & profile
explain: Company name, logo, colours, welcome text, services, contacts, emergency number, payment instructions and policies, without touching code.

title: Audit log
explain: Who did what and when: sign-ins, record views, status changes, payments and exports.
